root_cause.text: The block group tree's dirty_list node was being added to the switch_commits list unconditionally via list_add_tail(), but the block group tree already uses normal root dirty tracking which means its dirty_list is already linked to another list, causing double-insertion corruption of the linked list pointers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the explicit `list_add_tail(&fs_info->block_group_root->dirty_list, &cur_trans->switch_commits)` call that was added after commit 14033b08a029. The CVE description states: "the block group tree uses normal root dirty tracking and in any transaction that does an allocation and dirties a block group, the block group root will already be linked to a list by the dirty_list field and this use of list_add_tail() is invalid and corrupts the prev/next members of block_group_root->dirty_list." The list corruption error shows mismatched prev/next pointers, which is the classic symptom of attempting to insert a node that is already part of another list.
